name: Illinois Psychiatric Society Annual Meeting 2026
venue: William Tell Hotel (formerly Holiday Inn Countryside)
description: One day scientific meeting of the APA district branch for Illinois, held in the Chicago suburbs with a themed program, a trainee poster competition and an awards dinner. The 2026 theme is The Elephant in the Waiting Room: Confronting Today's Psychiatric Challenges.

deadlines.label: Poster abstract submission deadline (residents, fellows, medical students)
deadlines.note: Closed; the page states the submission deadline has passed and no longer shows the date. The 2025 deadline was July 31, 2025. Case and research categories judged separately; $250 first and $100 second prize per category.

deadlines.label: Standard registration deadline
deadlines.note: Poster presenters must be registered by the final deadline or their poster is disqualified.

sources.note: Confirms Saturday October 3, 2026, 1:00 to 9:00 PM, William Tell Hotel, 6201 Joliet Road, Countryside, IL 60525, registration deadlines and agenda.
Confirms poster competition eligibility, categories, prizes, and that the 2026 submission deadline has passed.
Event list; 2025 meeting September 6, 2025 with poster deadline July 31, 2025; IPS Meet and Greet at the APA Annual Meeting May 17, 2026.

notes: No separate APA Area 4 or Illinois resident research poster event was found; the IPS poster competition at the annual meeting is the Illinois trainee poster venue, and IPS hosts a networking Meet and Greet at the APA Annual Meeting. For 2027, expect a similar late summer poster deadline and a September or October meeting date; nothing published yet. Coordinates are approximate for the hotel at Joliet Road, Countryside.
